earnings.title: Moderna Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Updates
highlights: Reports second quarter revenue of $0.1 billion, GAAP net loss of $(0.8) billion and GAAP EPS of $(1.97)
Revenue : Total revenue for the second quarter of 2026 was $145 million, compared to $142 million in the same period in 2025.
Revenue was $87 million in the U.S. and $58 million in international markets.
Reiterates plan to deliver up to 10% revenue growth in 2026

Cost of Sales: Cost of sales for the second quarter of 2026 was $93 million, including $41 million of inventory write-downs, $23 million of unutilized manufacturing capacity costs, and $11 million of third-party royalties.

quotes.text: The second quarter marked another period of strong execution for Moderna as we advanced our pipeline and strengthened our financial profile with an improved 2026 operating expense outlook.
quotes.by: Stéphane Bancel, Chief Executive Officer of Moderna

outlook: Improves 2026 GAAP operating expense outlook by approximately $0.2 billion from previous estimate and improves expected 2026 year-end cash balance to $4.7 - 5.2 billion
Revenue: The Company is targeting up to 10% growth from 2025 revenue and expects 2026 revenue split to be approximately 50% U.S. and approximately 50% international.
Moderna expects approximately 55% of its second half 2026 revenue to be recognized in the third quarter.
Cost of Sales: Cost of sales for 2026 is expected to be approximately $1.7 billion, lowered from approximately $1.8 billion, and including the $0.9 billion non-recurring litigation settlement charge.
